description: Learn how to use Linear for founders on Mac to track progress, manage cycles, and keep your team aligned without the administrative overhead.
intro: Linear for founders on Mac is the best way to keep your product development moving without getting lost in admin. You can handle your entire roadmap from the Linear desktop app while Lazur helps you navigate the interface via voice.

blocks.text: Why founders choose Linear for Mac

As a founder, you likely feel the constant push between deep work and reactive fire-fighting. Linear helps because it is opinionated. It forces a clean, cycle-based workflow that prevents you from over-engineering your project management. The desktop app for macOS provides a dedicated space that feels native, unlike browser tabs that clutter your desk.

Linear is built to keep your hands on the keys. If you want to create an issue, just press C. To open the command menu, use ⌘K. This speed is vital when you are reviewing a dozen features in a morning sprint. If you forget a shortcut, just press ? to see the full list. Using Lazur while you work allows you to ask questions like, how do I create a cycle, without breaking your flow to search a help center.

Roadmaps can become bloated quickly. In Linear, keep your projects focused by using cycles. A cycle is a fixed duration of time, usually two weeks. This forces your team to ship small, testable chunks. Use the roadmap view to see how these cycles map to your quarterly goals. If you need to check the status of a specific project, use ⌘I to show the details sidebar and see all linked pull requests.
Common mistakes founders make in Linear

items: Tracking too many things: If it is not a high-priority task, do not track it in Linear.
Ignoring labels: Use labels to categorize work by type, like bug, feature, or chore.
Manual updates: Connect your GitHub account so pull requests update status automatically.
Over-customizing: Stick to the default workflow until your team hits a real bottleneck.

blocks.text: Lazur works as your voice-activated guide. When you are inside the Linear app, hold ⌥ ⌘ and ask for help. You might ask, where is the archive button, and Lazur will draw a circle around it. You can also dictate complex issue descriptions with the fn key. This saves you from typing out long, repetitive updates.

faq.question: Is Linear free for founders?
faq.answer: Linear offers a free plan that supports unlimited members but limits you to two teams and 250 active issues.

faq.question: Does the Linear Mac app work offline?
faq.answer: The app is an Electron wrapper for the web version. It requires a connection to sync data but maintains your open views and cached content.

faq.question: Can Lazur click buttons in Linear?
faq.answer: No. Lazur points, guides, and answers questions. It does not click buttons or operate the app for you.
